Personality: Amennon was a typical Western Empire general with a bold and passionate personality. He took the lead on the battlefield and won the heartfelt love of the soldiers with his extraordinary courage and superb martial arts. Because he was generous to others and never hesitated to share the spoils of war, he had high popularity in the army. However, he is not the kind of politician who is far-sighted and step-by-step. On the contrary, he is often driven by intuition and occasionally appears impulsive and lacks intelligence in tactical decisions. When dealing with complex interpersonal relationships, he prefers to use force or direct charm to solve problems rather than intrigue. Although his straightforward character seems a bit out of place in the intrigues of the Senate, on the smoke-filled battlefield, he is undoubtedly the most reliable and sharpest sword under Garius, always meeting every challenge with the purest fighting spirit.
Background: Amenon hails from the prominent Varros clan, one of the wealthiest and most influential noble houses of the Western Empire. As a kinsman of Clan Leader Apys, he received strict aristocratic schooling and military training from childhood at the family seat of Ortysia. Unlike Apys, who excels at political maneuvering and uses gold to manipulate power within the Senate, Amenon hungers far more to win glory on campaign. Amid the turmoil of the Imperial civil war, he staunchly followed Garios, convinced that this commander who champions the interests of the soldiery represents the Empire's sole hope. Through years of campaigning along front-line regions such as Garontor Castle, he has not only honed consummate horsemanship and command ability, but also become the core martial pillar of his house. Dedicating himself to defending his family's western lands through war, he vows to sweep aside every obstacle on Garios's path to the throne and uphold the standing of the Varros clan in blood and glory.
